briefing.opening: Good morning/afternoon, everyone. We will now begin the climate briefing for September 20, 2026.

sections.title: 🔴 Escalating Climate Crisis and Compound Disasters
sections.content: Recently, the patterns of disasters caused by climate change are fundamentally shifting, with an increase in 'compound disasters' and 'cascading disasters' where one disaster triggers another [13]. Internationally, consecutive droughts and floods are occurring [17], and in Nepal, floods have prompted scientists to link them to global warming and call for climate funding [20]. Nepal's case, with low greenhouse gas emissions but severe climate impacts, raises questions about 'climate justice' [1]. Domestically, due to heatwaves, farmed fish species are observed to be shifting to subtropical species [4], and in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, lobsters are migrating northward due to climate change, necessitating changes in fishing methods [18, 24].

sections.title: 🌍 International Community's Climate Response Discussions and Shifting Perceptions
sections.content: In the international community, calls to reconsider climate change response measures are growing [15], and the Speaker of the Angolan Parliament emphasized the need for stronger global cooperation to address climate change [16]. Meanwhile, 'energy' and 'climate crisis' have emerged as major issues in the U.S. midterm elections, acting as variables in voter perception [2, 22, 23]. In this regard, climate change was also mentioned as one of the main discussion topics in the reader submission section [14]. In Switzerland, thousands of citizens held large-scale protests against the government's inaction on the climate crisis, urging immediate action [19].

sections.title: 🇰🇷 South Korea's Accelerated Renewable Energy Transition and Challenges
sections.content: Domestically, the Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) has been reformed after 15 years, with competitive bidding and long-term contract methods to be introduced starting next year [6]. The successful conclusion of the 2026 Saemangeum Clean Energy Expo has provided an opportunity for Gunsan to emerge as a 'renewable energy capital' [8]. Due to grid modernization and the expansion of renewable energy, the market for steel grounding electrodes and vacuum interrupter tubes is expected to grow at an average annual rate of 4-6% until 2035, anticipating growth in related markets [9, 11]. At the corporate level, Oracle has secured 1.7GW of clean energy, putting pressure on Korean companies to accelerate their carbon-neutral transition [5]. Lotte Chilsung is also strengthening its ESG management across its entire value chain, aiming to achieve carbon neutrality by 2040 [12]. However, amidst the rapid push for 100GW of renewable energy, 'grid bottleneck' issues are being raised [7], and coal power plant workers are demanding guaranteed total employment and the expansion of public renewable energy, emphasizing social justice in the transition process [10].

sections.title: 🌱 Ecosystem Restoration Efforts
sections.content: In positive news, there was a report that the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change is pushing for the restoration of the Houtan grasslands in the Al Shamal region [21]. This is considered an important effort to reduce ecosystem damage caused by climate change and enhance natural resilience.

briefing.closing: Through today's briefing, we were able to confirm the severity of the climate crisis, along with various domestic and international efforts and challenges to overcome it. This is a critical time when continuous attention and cooperation are urgently needed. This concludes the climate briefing for September 20, 2026.
